nfl_2026_10_SF_DAL.summary: The NFC-leading 49ers keep adding: Keenan Allen arrived by trade and Deebo Samuel expects to return after missing three games, though Mike Evans is out and both starting outside corners are hurt. The 4-5 Cowboys are banged up, with Jake Ferguson, Tyler Goodson and PJ Locke out and George Pickens questionable.

items.text: C Lucas Patrick (concussion) and TE Colson Yankoff (knee) ruled out; Nick Allegretti starts at center.
WR Treylon Burks (foot) missed Wednesday's practice but carries no game status; WRs Terry McLaurin and Dyami Brown remain on IR.
QB J.J. McCarthy (hip) and RB Cam Skattebo (hamstring) were full participants with no game status; LB Malik Harrison (groin) is questionable.
CB Colton Hood (finger) practiced fully with no game status and looks set to return after a multi-game absence.

nfl_2026_10_WAS_NYG.summary: A short-week NFC East game in a Giants White Out. The 5-2-1 Giants lead the division and are nearly healthy: J.J. McCarthy (hip) and Cam Skattebo practiced fully with no game status. The 2-5-1 Commanders start Nick Allegretti at center for the concussed Lucas Patrick and remain thin at receiver.
